prompt: Please write a short story based on the cartoon Futurama, where Fry asks the what if machine "What if I my trousers & underpants dropped to my ankles whilst I was stood outside a school"
response: Fry steps outside a school, and suddenly his trousers and underpants drop to his ankles. He quickly pulls them back up and walks away, embarrassed. Meanwhile, the What If Machine observes and records the event, but there are no significant consequences, and Fry goes back to his usual routine.
